purpose: Tie one PDF screen review to exact output bytes, all pages, intended use and size, findings, and reviewer/date evidence.
artifact_pin: Safe receipt-relative PDF path and exact lowercase SHA-256 digest.
rules: Every PDF page must have exactly one numbered page record and a pinned PNG preview.
The receipt's page sizes must match the PDF page boxes within 0.5 pt.
A passed receipt has no blocking findings.
Changed PDF or preview bytes invalidate the receipt.
A pinned family visual reference and at least one signature feature must be reviewed; a passed review cannot leave a feature missing.
This validates review evidence, not the reviewer's subjective judgment or physical print readiness.
